name: How do you ensure the finish carpentry aligns with the overall design of a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure the finish carpentry aligns with the overall design of a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures finish carpentry aligns with the overall design of a remodel through our integrated design-build process. From the initial concept and CAD-supported layouts, finish carpentry elements are planned as a cohesive part of the entire project, rather than an afterthought. Our team carefully considers how trim, moldings, and built-ins complement other selections like cabinetry, flooring, and paint colors to create a harmonized aesthetic. This single point of coordination guarantees that every detail contributes to the overarching design vision, reflecting the craftsmanship and quality we commit to from consultation to final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group aligns finish carpentry with remodel designs through an integrated design-build process, planning elements from concept to ensure cohesion with all other selections.
